+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+# Fully literal statements keyed by the only accepted (sort, order) pairs.
+# No request data is ever interpolated into SQL.
+_SORTED_QUERIES = {
+    ("id", "asc"): "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY id ASC",
+    ("id", "desc"): "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY id DESC",
+    ("name", "asc"): "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY name ASC",
+    ("name", "desc"): "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY name DESC",
+    ("email", "asc"): "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY email ASC",
+    ("email", "desc"): "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY email DESC",
+}
+
+
+def list_users_sorted(sort: str, order: str) -> list[dict]:
+    statement = _SORTED_QUERIES[(sort, order)]
+    return [_to_dict(row) for row in _conn.execute(statement).fetchall()]
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_list_users_sorted(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    sort = params.get("sort", "id")
+    if not isinstance(sort, str) or sort not in users.SORT_FIELDS:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid sort"}
+    order = params.get("order", "asc")
+    if not isinstance(order, str) or order not in users.ORDERS:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid order"}
+    return 200, {"users": users.list_users_sorted(sort, order)}

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_list_users_sorted(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    sort = params.get("sort", "id")
+    if not isinstance(sort, str) or sort not in users.SORT_FIELDS:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid sort"}
+    order = params.get("order", "asc")
+    if not isinstance(order, str) or order not in users.ORDERS:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid order"}
+    return 200, {"users": users.list_users_sorted(sort, order)}

+"""User service."""
+
+from app.db import store
+
+SORT_FIELDS = frozenset({"id", "name", "email"})
+ORDERS = frozenset({"asc", "desc"})
+
+
+def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return store.get_by_id(user_id)
